verdict.rationale: Resend mentions 'automations' for building recurring marketing flows (resend-docs-12), which is the closest match to event-triggered rules, but only as a single thin line. Its event features are webhooks that notify on email and inbound events (resend-docs-6, resend-docs-11, resend-docs-18), which leave the user to build the actions in their own code rather than defining rules in the product. missing for 10: documented rule/trigger/condition configuration for automations, a list of supported trigger events and actions, API/MCP access to define automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration of automations.
